summary: Added _container_records to sdk/state/client_provider.py: it locates the container element (Rooms, Researches, Characters, Items) and returns [] when the container is present with no records, or None only when the container is absent. Rooms and research now use it; crew and inventory use it and fall back to the previous record search when no container exists. Added three regression tests: empty containers give complete, empty sections with no failed reads; absent containers stay missing; and baseline-v1 plans research for a new ship whose Researches element is empty. Both defect tests fail against the previous provider and pass with the fix. Documented the rule in docs/baseline/account-snapshot.md.

contract_status_changes.contract: Snapshot section observation for empty containers
contract_status_changes.before: A present but empty Rooms/Researches/Characters/Items element was reported as missing, blocking planning for new ships
contract_status_changes.after: Present empty containers are observed and empty; only absent containers or failed reads are missing
proof: tests.test_client_snapshot_provider: 11 tests OK; the 2 defect tests fail on the unfixed provider

residual_risks: The fix assumes the server always includes the container element when the read succeeds; that is inferred from client code and mocked payloads, not a live capture.
